mutations.name: the epoch guard is removed from the mint path: a GetUserJwt mint racing a logout/rotation caches and hands out a stale JWT. This is the monotonic-cacheEpoch invalidation the gap explicitly called for — without it, a logout followed by an in-flight mint repopulates a credential for the dead session

the user_jwt gate inverts: Metadata field 21 is attached only when NO jwt is provided (and withheld when one is). The wire never carries the JWT even with WINDSURFAPI_USER_JWT=1 — the credential the feature exists to send never ships, and the no-jwt wire becomes non-identical to the old shape
